Question: What are some unique aspects of Ravel’s compositions?
Answer: Ravel studied chords and sonority. Try a simple test: . Get a piano . Play a simple major chord, like Do-mi-so-do. . Now, press the pedal and play it again without releasing the pedal . Listen The sound is very different. The reason is that, when all the piano cords are released, they all vibrate. Some more than others, depending on the notes played. It is that effect that gives a “spacial” feel to the chord you play. Ravel studied that. Although the Braun tube had not been invented yet, he could identify many of those extra notes that would make that “spacial” effect of pressing the piano pedal. And so, he augmented the chords, including extra notes. This technique gave his music a specific sonority, which is part of the reason why many consider him the best orchestrator of all time. Worth mentioning Messiaen, who, using the Braun tube to look at sound, further extended the chords, going much further than Ravel.

Question: How will global warming affect aircraft materials and construction?
Answer: As to materials and construction, absolutely nothing. Airplanes are already being made as efficient as possible. The idea always was to make them spend the least possible fuel, and for that the only way to go is making more efficient engines, lighter frames and improved aerodynamics. We have two ways to go. We either go for alternative fuels, like hydrogen, or abandon the current technology for engines and go electric. Tupolev built a hydrogen fueled plane in 1988, the TU 155. It worked and flew well, but that just reduced the payload of the plane, making it more expensive to fly. That is an alternative, though. We already have hybrid airplanes flying and in the drawing board, as a step to full electric airplanes. That won’t happen tomorrow, though. We already have small electric planes, in the market formerly occupied by single engine small planes. The autonomy is still not great, though. However, they are ideal for flight schools, as their maintenance is much cheaper.
